steps.say: Narrow the list to one kind of problem at a time — errors first, so the breakages get seen before the nitpicks.
Dismiss says the CHECKER was wrong, not the content — the phrase stays exactly as it is. Use it whenever the flag is a false positive.
Approving deletes every flag you did NOT dismiss, so dismiss first and approve last. Nothing goes until you tap this.
steps.terminal: Dismiss the false positives, then approve once. This clip changed nothing — only your own taps do.
